headline: The 3.4% Income Play That Beats the Dogs of the Dow Strategy
summary: Applying the Dogs of the Dow logic across the entire S&P 500 sounds like a recipe for chasing troubled dividends, but a holding-by-holding look at SDOG reveals a more complicated picture, with two positions that deserve serious scrutiny before you commit capital.

headline: Johnson & Johnson Is Becoming A Narrower Company Than You Bought
summary: Management's plain health care label has slipped out of the lead, and the business now on a separation clock is the one that finally started working.
